description: Main Kobo form: one district weekly meningitis report (IDSR style).

16-week ahead forecast per district from the prediction model.
Accuracy of the outbreak prediction model on training (2023-2025) and test (2026) data.
Logistic regression coefficients (standardised features) and odds ratios.
Suspected cases / population x 100,000 for the week.
WHO thresholds: Alert >= 3 per 100k per week, Epidemic >= 10 per 100k per week.
